rollback_order: 1. SQL step 11 rollback: drop world_contributor_research_v2 (v1 untouched) - ALWAYS before rolling the site back
2. Site: re-alias Production to the previous 2029 deployment (read it from get_alias before the forward move)
3. Edge: redeploy each function from edge-rollback/ (node scripts/m0-edge-rollback-assemble.mjs <slug>), same entrypoint and verify_jwt
4. Remaining SQL steps in reverse order of the apply list, each with its ROLLBACK file
rollback_order_reason: The fixed order keeps the public site from ever running code older than the data it reads. With v2 the reverse order is also safe (an old site reads v1 only), but the plan keeps one order so that no rollback depends on that reasoning being re-checked.
